question: What materials for vessels are enumerated in response to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are mentioned
Vessels born of tortoise are mentioned
Vessels made of bell-metal and copper metal are mentioned
inference: Acceptable vessels include those made of clay, tortoise shell, bell-metal, and copper.
uncertainties: kūrmajaṃ may refer specifically to a tortoise shell vessel
plain_english: O Goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell-metal, or made of copper.
